description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) TEMPERAMENTAL SHOKKA (Madcap Meks Upgrade, Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun; in your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can roll one D6: 1 — the Shokk Attack Gun has [TORRENT] and, after the unit has shot, the bearer is destroyed; 2-5 — +1 A; 6 — [SUSTAINED HITS 2]) and MEKWAAAGH! MASTERMIND (passive: this model's unit is riled up). Fixture ork11e_enh_madcap_shoot. At the Shooting phase start Boyz C and their Big Mek are riled up (Mekwaaagh!). The ShootingController auto-selects the Big Mek with SAG (Shokk Attack Gun pre-assigned to Custodian Guard B), so its unit_selected_to_shoot window is deferred to the player's first action: a real click on 'Confirm (1 weapons)' opens the window with the 0-CP Upgrade card; a real click on 'Use' rolls the D6 (deterministic in this harness) and the rolled effect is on the Shokk Attack Gun's attack modifiers; the card is gone (once per phase); the held Confirm resumes and the SAG shoots Custodian Guard B and the effect is cleared once the unit has shot. The AI never uses it (a 1 destroys the Big Mek — headless). Setup privilege: auto wound allocation.

steps.comment: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind (passive): the Big Mek's Attached unit is riled up (re-asserted at every phase start)

steps.script:
var m = load("res://scripts/codex/orks/OrkAbilities11e.gd").attack_mods(GameState.get_unit("U_BIG_MEK_WITH_SHOKK_ATTACK_GUN_A"), GameState.get_unit("U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"), {"name": "Shokk Attack Gun", "type": "Ranged"}, false, GameState.state, [])
return "A+%d S%d T%s" % [int(m.get("attacks", 0)), int(m.get("sustained", 0)), str(bool(m.get("torrent", false)))]
steps.comment: before: the Shokk Attack Gun is unmodified
the ShootingController auto-selected the Big Mek with SAG at phase entry: its unit_selected_to_shoot window is deferred to the player's first action with it (LV-2)

steps.script:
var f = GameState.get_unit("U_BIG_MEK_WITH_SHOKK_ATTACK_GUN_A").flags.get("ork11e_enh_tshokka", {})
var r := int(f.get("result", 0)) if f is Dictionary else 0
print("[wp-o5] Temperamental Shokka rolled ", r)
return r >= 1 and r <= 6
steps.comment: the D6 result is recorded on the Big Mek
the rolled effect is on the Shokk Attack Gun: 1 [TORRENT], 2-5 +1 A, 6 [SUSTAINED HITS 2]
the Shokk Attack Gun's attack resolved
the effect ends once the unit has shot (flag cleared)
